controls.title: Single agent trust root
controls.requirement: AGENTS.md is the only repository-wide AI-agent governance authority; provider adapters may not define competing global rules.

controls.title: Stable authority identity
controls.requirement: Every new normative governance artifact has one immutable AUTH-* identity independent of path or display number.

controls.title: Deterministic supersession
controls.requirement: Recency only orders versions of the same stable authority identity; cross-authority replacement requires an explicit supersedes edge and Owner-visible impact analysis.

controls.title: Unique active ADR and ESS namespaces
controls.requirement: No two active ADR or ESS artifacts may expose the same canonical display ID. Historical aliases remain explicit and non-authorizing.

controls.title: New or touched ADR registration
controls.requirement: Every new or materially migrated ADR is registered with stable authorityId, unique active displayId, version, date, lifecycle and supersession/alias metadata before merge-readiness.

controls.title: Canonical document placement and lifecycle
controls.requirement: New governance, architecture, compliance, runbook, roadmap and evidence documents use their canonical docs domain and required lifecycle metadata; root Markdown is restricted to approved roots/adapters.

controls.title: Historical evidence is retained but non-authorizing
controls.requirement: Superseded decisions, historical runbooks, evidence and reports remain traceable and may not silently regain current authority through age, location or citation.

controls.title: Governance integrity before feature readiness
controls.requirement: A feature may not become merge-ready while a correlated critical governance identity, authority or control-plane conflict remains unresolved.

controls.title: Fresh scoped branch
controls.requirement: Repository changes are made only on a fresh scoped branch from current main; direct main edits are prohibited.

controls.title: Final main synchronization
controls.requirement: Immediately before PR creation, refresh main, correlate newly merged changes, synchronize the branch and repeat necessary low-cost checks.

controls.title: Pre-PR evidence is non-authorizing
controls.requirement: Local or sandbox build/test evidence must be bound to the exact candidate SHA and never authorizes PR creation, merge or production mutation.

controls.title: Independent hosted technical validation
controls.requirement: GitHub hosted build-and-test remains the independent technical check for the final PR head before Human Merge.

controls.title: M10 passkey gate remains suspended
controls.requirement: M10 AUTHORIZE_PR_CI is suspended/off. Historical M10 evidence or runbooks cannot reactivate it; reactivation requires a new explicit Owner decision and validated control change.

controls.title: Human-only merge
controls.requirement: AI agents may not self-merge; a separate explicit Human/Owner merge decision is required for the concrete PR.

controls.title: Single verified production deployment authority
controls.requirement: Render native auto-deploy remains off; production promotion occurs through verified main CI, supply-chain attestation, exact-SHA deploy hook and post-deployment identity verification.

controls.title: Reusable secrets stay outside evidence and model output
controls.requirement: Secrets, reusable credentials, private passkey material and raw sensitive tokens must not be committed or reproduced in model-visible evidence.

controls.title: Least privilege and fail-closed security ambiguity
controls.requirement: Protected workflows and external mutations preserve least privilege and fail closed on unresolved security-critical ambiguity.

controls.title: Governance continual improvement
controls.requirement: Governance controls are planned, implemented, evaluated and improved with dated evidence and explicit change ownership; repository documentation must not claim ISO certification solely from this alignment.

controls.title: No unsupported certification or regulatory-status claims
controls.requirement: Engineering alignment to ISO/NIST or repository controls does not establish certification, regulated-entity status, high-risk AI classification or complete legal compliance without independent scope/evidence.
